description: Header file defining the CryptoFramer class and related interfaces for handling cryptographic message framing in QUIC protocol implementation.

classes.name: CryptoFramer
classes.description: Handles framing and parsing of cryptographic messages exchanged in QUIC sessions.

classes.name: CryptoFramerVisitorInterface
classes.description: Interface for callback methods invoked during crypto message framing, such as error handling and handshake message processing.

methods.name: ParseMessage
methods.description: Parses exactly one crypto handshake message from input data.

methods.name: set_visitor
methods.description: Sets the visitor callback interface for framing events.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Returns the last error code encountered.

methods.name: ProcessInput
methods.description: Processes input data for framing, with optional encryption level parameter.

methods.name: InputBytesRemaining
methods.description: Returns the number of unprocessed bytes remaining.

methods.name: HasTag
methods.description: Checks if a specific tag has been seen in the current message.

methods.name: ForceHandshake
methods.description: Forces processing of the handshake message even if incomplete.

methods.name: ConstructHandshakeMessage
methods.description: Creates a serialized handshake message from a CryptoHandshakeMessage object.

methods.name: set_process_truncated_messages
methods.description: Enables processing of truncated messages for debugging.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Internal method to process input data, returning an error code.

methods.name: WritePadTag
methods.description: Static method to write padding tags into a QuicDataWriter.
